title: Two Sessions of Coach-Delivered Core Transformation for Distress and Well-Being
official: Two Sessions of Coach-Delivered Core Transformation for Psychological Distress and Well-Being in Community Adults: A Randomized Waitlist-Controlled Trial
summary:
The goal of this study is to learn if Core Transformation, a guided coaching process, lowers psychological distress in adults. It will also look at well-being, daily functioning, and whether any changes last over time. The main questions it aims to answer are:

* Do people who have two Core Transformation sessions have less psychological distress after their second session than people who are still waiting for their sessions?
* Do any changes last up to 12 months after the sessions?
* Do participants feel better about the issue they chose to work on?

Researchers will compare a group that has the sessions earlier with a group that has the same sessions about 2 weeks later (a waitlist group).

Participants will:

* Choose one moderate issue to work on
* Be placed by chance into an earlier-start group or a later-start group
* Have two one-on-one online video coaching sessions with a Core Transformation coach (a coach in training or a certified coach), about one week apart. Sessions are recorded.
* Complete online surveys before the sessions; at about 4 weeks (after the sessions for the immediate arm, and before the sessions for the delayed treatment arm); at about 6 weeks (after the sessions for the delayed treatment arm); and for long-term follow-up at about 3, 6 and 12 months after the second session.

Everyone in the study is offered the sessions.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. Aged 18 or over.
2. Able to read, speak and understand English well enough to complete the surveys and CT sessions.
3. Has internet access and a device that can run Zoom, and is able to attend two online sessions of about 90 minutes, about one week apart.
4. Gives informed consent online.
5. Agrees to have both CT sessions video-recorded

Exclusion Criteria:

1. Severe range at screening, or at the re-check before randomization: PHQ-8 of 20 or more, or GAD-7 of 15 or more.
2. Started, stopped or changed psychotherapy or psychiatric medication in the past 3 months. (Stable care that started earlier is not an exclusion.)
3. Has been guided through the Core Transformation process before, or has guided themselves through it.
